title: A$AP Rocky Responds to Drake’s ‘Where She At’ Diss on ‘Burning Bridges’: ‘It’s Just Bugged Out to Me’
summary: Rocky sat down with Jason Lee recently and discussed his severed relationship with Drake.
contentText:
A$AP Rocky is over the drama between himself and Drake .

The Harlem rapper and actor stopped by The Jason Lee Show recently and was asked directly if he would be open to fighting his former friend in a celebrity boxing match, to which Rocky said he was not interested in at all. He also addressed Drake’s disses on “Burning Bridges,” on which the Toronto rapper asked why Rihanna didn’t help promote Rocky’s latest project Don’t Be Dumb .

“He don’t wanna see me,” Rocky said about Lee’s celebrity boxing idea.” F— some gloves, n—a. Bare knuckle, like the Irish. We ain’t doin’ all that celebrity boxing sh–.”

And when it came to the “Your baby mama ain’t even post your single, damn/ Where she at? Yeah, where she at,” lines on “Burning Bridges,” Rocky explained that the jab doesn’t make sense to him. “That’s stupid,” he said. “This is the problem, though: If she would’ve posted my album, everybody would have been like, ‘You only went No. 1 ’cause your girl posted.’ … She not on my f—ing album. What single she supposed to be posting? She posted my album … after it went No. 1.”

“Everybody done moved on with their lives and motherf—as still strung up on that sh–,” he added after Lee jokingly asked if he took Drake’s girl. “It’s just bugged out to me. The Internet antics and smear campaigns and all that, we see right through that. That’s why I just be like, ‘I ain’t responding to that.'”

According to A$AP, his issues with Drake stem from when he started dating Rihanna around 2020. “I thought [Drake] was my mans. I thought he was my dude,” he told Akademiks in an interview earlier this year. “I first met him and he seemed embraceful and sh–. We went on tour with him. I think when I got with [Rihanna], he started throwing shots out of nowhere. I just woke up and felt like he was throwing subs and sh–.”

Rocky also watched never-before-seen footage of his daughter crawling for the first time and talked about how Rihanna has always been there for him whether it be as a friend or romantic partner.
